paper.title: MolMiner: Fragment-Based, Geometry-Aware, and Order-Agnostic Molecular Generation

questions.question: How can multi-step autoregressive molecular generation avoid fixed rollout ordering while maintaining chemical validity and incorporating dynamic 3D geometry?
How to resolve attachment ambiguities arising from fragment symmetries during canonicalization and autoregressive assembly?

proposed_methods.name: MolMiner
proposed_methods.architecture: Fragment-based decoder-only transformer with distance-based geometric attention bias and order-agnostic rollout sampling

limitations: Relies on disk-based I/O bottleneck in data ingestion during multi-rollout training.
Geometry awareness depends on force-field relaxation rather than direct end-to-end 3D coordinate generation.

paper.title: SO3LR Tauri: Generally Applicable Force Fields for Reactive (Bio)Molecular Simulations Covering the Periodic Table

questions.question: How can machine-learned force fields achieve general applicability across the periodic table while maintaining quantum-mechanical accuracy for both reactive and condensed-phase biomolecular dynamics?

Can explicit, physics-based long-range and short-range modules combined with multi-head multi-fidelity learning accurately describe non-covalent interactions, proton transfers, and transition states without system-specific parameterization?

proposed_methods.name: SO3LR Tauri
proposed_methods.architecture: Equivariant SO3krates message-passing neural network combined with explicit pair-specific Nordlund-Lehtola-Hobler (NLH) short-range repulsion, environment-dependent quantum Drude oscillator dispersion, and particle-mesh Ewald damped electrostatics

limitations: Over-structuring of hydrogen-bond networks in liquid water causes self-diffusion to be underestimated by approximately a factor of two compared to experiment.
Liquid densities of neat organic solvents have a mean relative error of 6.3%, deviating more than classical empirical force fields like OPLS4.
Pairwise electrostatic and dispersion approximations ignore non-local, anisotropic many-body dispersion and collective polarization effects.
The sugar pucker in B-DNA exhibits an unphysical excess population near the O4'-endo conformation.
Evaluation on domain-decomposed multi-billion-atom configurations is currently limited to force evaluations with real-space cutoffs rather than full long-range PME integration.

paper.title: AntiFold: antibody-specific inverse folding for structure-based antibody design

questions.question: How can a general protein inverse folding model be fine-tuned to capture antibody-specific loop constraints and maintain CDR sequence recovery?
How does loop length in the highly variable CDRH3 region affect the sequence recovery of antibody inverse folding?

proposed_methods.name: AntiFold
proposed_methods.architecture: ESM-IF1 backbone with IMGT-weighted masking, layer-wise learning rate decay, and antibody structure fine-tuning

modules.module_name: Inverse folding sequence scoring and logit extraction

observations.subject: AntiFold on short CDRH3 loops (6-9 residues)
AntiFold on long CDRH3 loops (16-28 residues)

limitations: AntiFold sequence recovery is markedly lower for longer CDRH3 loops compared to shorter loops.

paper.title: Discovery of novel antimicrobial peptides with notable antibacterial potency by a LLM-based foundation model

questions.question: How can large language foundation models be adapted to generate novel, diverse antimicrobial peptides without overfitting to small labeled datasets?
Can knowledge distillation compress a prompt-tuned foundation model into a lightweight recurrent architecture to enable computationally efficient reinforcement learning fine-tuning?

Can multi-property reward-guided reinforcement learning yield antimicrobial peptides that demonstrate high broad-spectrum in vitro bactericidal potency and in vivo therapeutic efficacy against drug-resistant Gram-negative bacterial infections?

proposed_methods.name: AMP-Designer
proposed_methods.architecture: A deep generative framework combining GPT pre-training, contrastive soft prompt tuning, knowledge distillation into GRU, and multi-objective reinforcement learning.

proposed_methods.name: AMP-GPT
proposed_methods.architecture: Autoregressive decoder-only Transformer based on GPT-2 small (12 layers, 8 attention heads) pre-trained on UniProt natural peptides.

proposed_methods.name: AMP-Prompt
proposed_methods.architecture: Prefix prompt-tuned AMP-GPT with frozen base parameters optimized via contrastive discriminative and language modeling loss.

proposed_methods.name: AMP-Distillation
proposed_methods.architecture: A lightweight 3-layer GRU recurrent neural network trained by soft-target knowledge distillation on softmax probabilities from AMP-Prompt.

proposed_methods.name: AMP-MIC
proposed_methods.architecture: Fine-tuned AMP-GPT regressor architecture predicting bacterial strain-specific minimum inhibitory concentrations.

paper.title: Generation of 3D Molecules in Pockets via Language Model

questions.question: How can language models and geometric deep learning be effectively integrated to generate 3D molecules directly in protein pockets without creating unrealistic topologies or non-drug-like substructures?
How can local and global coordinate systems be combined within an autoregressive generation framework to ensure both rigid local substructures and global binding context?

proposed_methods.name: Lingo3DMol
proposed_methods.architecture: Transformer-based encoder-decoder with dual 2D/3D decoders and auxiliary NCI/Anchor prediction

modules.input_schema: atom_type, coords, main_side, residue, hbd_hba, nci_anchor
Q, K, V, distance_matrix D, edge_vector_matrix J

modules.module_name: Clash Avoidance and DFS Reward Sampling

limitations: Capturing all non-covalent interactions within a single molecule remains challenging due to the autoregressive generation process.
The model relies on data augmentation and SE(3)-invariant representations rather than full SE(3) equivariance.
The generation does not strictly guarantee exact positioning relative to all predicted pocket NCI positions.

paper.title: Mol-Instructions: A Large-Scale Biomolecular Instruction Dataset for Large Language Models

questions.question: How can biomolecular data and tasks across small molecules, proteins, and biomolecular text be structured into instruction-following formats for large language models?
Does instruction tuning LLMs on dedicated biomolecular instructions improve domain-specific comprehension and task execution in chemistry and biology?

proposed_methods.name: Mol-Instructions
proposed_methods.architecture: Biomolecular instruction tuning dataset comprising molecule-oriented, protein-oriented, and biomolecular text instructions

limitations: Distinct representation spaces between natural language text and biomolecules hinder fluent bio-language comprehension.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning like LoRA may impose expressivity limitations on learning biomolecular representations.
Vocabulary expansion and multi-modal integration with specialized biomolecular encoders are required for deeper molecular understanding.

paper.title: MOLGEN: Pre-trained Molecular Language Model for Molecule Generation

questions.question: How can pre-trained molecular language models overcome the syntactic brittleness of SMILES and effectively cover both synthetic and natural product domains?
How can molecular hallucinations be mitigated to ensure generated molecules exhibit expected chemical and biological activity?

proposed_methods.name: MOLGEN
proposed_methods.architecture: Bidirectional and Auto-regressive Transformer (BART) with prefix tuning and chemical feedback paradigm

limitations: Does not currently support reaction prediction or retrosynthesis tasks.
Lacks multimodal pre-training and incorporation of external knowledge sources.

questions.question: Can speculative sampling be generalized to second-order Langevin dynamics to accelerate serial molecular dynamics simulations while provably preserving the target distribution?
How do system characteristics such as atom count, temperature, and draft-target pairing determine achievable speedup and rejection rates in speculative molecular dynamics?

proposed_methods.name: Langevin Speculative Dynamics
proposed_methods.architecture: Speculative sampling framework for Langevin dynamics combining fast draft potential proposals, parallel target verification, and stochastic transport acceptance/rejection

limitations: Performance is strongly system-size dependent, with rejection rates becoming prohibitive for systems with more than O(10^3) atoms
Speedups for smaller systems are often constrained by the computational cost fraction of the draft model
Focuses on throughput under the assumption of abundant parallel compute, which may not always be practical
